THE ANTIQUITIES ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 188)
Notiﬁ cation under Section 33

BY VIRTUE of the powers vested in me by Section 33 of the Antiquities Ordinance (Chapter 188), I, K.A.D.R. Nishanthi Jayasinghe, Director General of Archaeology, do by this notiﬁ cation declare with the approval of the Land Commissioner, that the area of state land speciﬁ ed in the Schedule, to this Notiﬁ cation, shall be an “archaeological reserve” for the purposes of the aforesaid Ordinance.
K.A.D.R. Nංඌඁൺඇඍඁං Jൺඒൺඌංඇ඀ඁൾ, Director General of Archaeology.
Colombo,27th December, 2023.

SCHEDULE
Area Reserved For Archaeological Purposes Of UththuwelliyaDematamalgama

The allotment of land in the extent of Sixteen decimal Six Seven Nine Five Hectares (16.6795 Hectrares) depicted as Lot ‛A’ in the Plan No. AA/DSO/2020/364 surveyed and made on 30.07.2020 by the Surveyor General of Land called Uththuwelliya, Dematamalgama Situated in the Village Bogoda, Dematamalgama in Grama Niladhari's Division No. 367 of Dematamalgama in Wilachchiya North Korale in Divisional Secretary Division in Mahawilachchiya in Anuradhapura District in the North Central Province and bounded on the North, East, South and West by the reservation of Dematamalgama of No. 3232 in the preliminary Plan No. 02.
